source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A full, months-long orientation matching what a brand-new permanent hire would typically receive over their first several weeks","B":"Facility-specific orientation covering essential policies, procedures, and unit-specific information, even if abbreviated","C":"Orientation provided mainly if the agency nurse happens to ask for it upon arrival to the unit","D":"Very little orientation, on the assumption that agency staff already know most of what they need going in"}}
source_row.rationale: Facilities should ensure agency nurses receive facility-specific orientation covering essential policies, procedures, and unit-specific information, even if abbreviated compared to a new permanent hire.
source_row.source_name: The Joint Commission — Contract/Agency Staff Orientation Standards
